name: Multithreaded Volume Rendering Pipeline
definition: A hardware optimization technique that overcomes data hazards in pipelined volume rendering by processing multiple rays (threads) in a round-robin order. It solves the problem where subsequent sample point addresses depend on the distance value of the current sample point, which causes pipeline stalls due to memory read delays.
summary: The Multithreaded Volume Rendering Pipeline is a hardware optimization that uses round-robin context switching to hide memory latency and maintain high pipeline utilization during volume rendering.
